items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is not an insured peril under §2.1 and is expressly excluded under §3.1.4. Sections 4.3(d)–(f) also exclude personal belongings taken from a car away from the insured site, so the payable threshold is €0.
Section 4.3(e) excludes the private car, and §5.2.5 expressly excludes vehicle-related expenses. The payable threshold is €0.
